spans.s: ध्यांक्षः see ध्वांक्ष.

ध्यात, ध्यान, ध्यानिक &c. See
under ध्यै.

ध्यात p. p. [ध्यै-क्त] Thought of,
meditated or reflected upon.

ध्यात, ध्यान, ध्यानिक &c. See
under ध्यै.

ध्यान [ध्यै-भावे-ल्युट्]
1 Meditation,
reflection, thought, contemplation;
ज्ञानाद् ध्यानं विशिष्यते

.
--2 Especially,
abstract contemplation, religious
meditation; तदैव ध्यानादवगतोऽस्मि Ś. 7;

.
--3 Divine intuition or
discernment.
--4 Mental
representation of the personal attributes of a
deity;
इति ध्यानं

.
--Comp.
--गम्य a.
attainable by meditation only.
--तत्पर, --निष्ठ, --पर a. lost in thought,
absorbed in meditation,
contemplative.
--मात्रं mere thought or
reflection.
--योगः profound
meditation.
--स्थ a. absorbed in
meditation, lost in thought.

ध्यात, ध्यान, ध्यानिक &c. See
under ध्यै.

ध्यानिक a. Sought or obtained
by pious contemplation or abstract
meditation.

ध्याम a. Unclean, dirty, black,
soiled;

.
--मं A kind of
grass.

ध्यामन् m.
1 Measure.
--2 Light.
--n. Meditation (less correctly
ध्मामन्).

ध्या Thought, meditation,
reflection.

ध्यातव्य, ध्येय a.
1 To be
meditated upon, to be contemplated.
--2 Fit
for meditation.
--3 To be imagined
or conceived.
